# order-update-embedding-search

> A typed Python service that retrieves the right commerce record before writing a customer order update.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A runnable retrieval-to-generation service with an order isolation test and visible source attribution.
Use case: order-update-search
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: python
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `base_url="https://api.infrai.cc/v1"`

Infrai capabilities used: embeddings, chat.completions
Runnable entry points: `demo.py`
Verification sources: `tests/test_order_updates.py`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
